Title: INSERTing into a table named 'table' fails

INSERT INTO table VALUES (42, 24); -- Code: 62. DB::Exception: Syntax error: failed at position 27 ('42'): 42, 24);. Expected one of: list of elements, insert element, COLUMNS matcher, COLUMNS, qualified asterisk, compound identifier, identifier, asterisk. (SYNTAX_ERROR)
